rules.title: Isolytic damage has its own track
rules.description: Isolytic damage scales with total standard damage before enemy standard mitigation. Isolytic defense reduces this parallel track.
rules.formula: Isolytic = standard damage × isolytic bonus / (1 + isolytic defense)
rules.coverage: Implemented for explicit ship/research values and supported active officer abilities. Conditional abilities are disclosed separately.

rules.title: Gorn Hunters resist conventional weapons
rules.description: Gorn Hunters are immune to non-isolytic damage. A standard-damage crew cannot defeat them, regardless of its raw attack.
rules.coverage: Standard immunity is enforced for Gorn Hunter. Other curated Gorn variants are not automatically treated as verified Hunters. Incoming isolytic magnitude must be supplied from the target or battle log.

rules.title: Apex extends effective health
rules.description: Every 10,000 Apex Barrier doubles the base amount of damage a ship can sustain. It acts on both incoming damage tracks once.
rules.coverage: Implemented as effective health, including an explicit enemy Apex Shred fraction. Scoped research and conditional effects need verified inputs. Armada-specific Apex behavior is not modelled.

rules.title: Critical Mitigation uses points
rules.description: Scopely’s example gives 62.41% reduction at 83,000 points. Add point sources before resolving their effective reduction.
rules.coverage: Curve inferred from the official example. Source scope is enforced. Legacy decimal fields remain effective-reduction overrides until replaced with points; they are labelled in recommendations.

rules.title: The source must match the encounter
rules.description: Remote Campus applies to Academy encounters. The Programmable Matter Beam’s documented benefit is PvP. Simulacrum refits require eligible ships and a matching PvP or Academy encounter.
rules.coverage: Source scope and refit ownership are enforced. Academy access requires Operations 61. Duo recommendations stop if no candidate ship has an applicable source.

rules.title: The combat triangle has a direction
rules.description: Interceptors are favored against Battleships; Battleships against Explorers; Explorers against Interceptors. Strike teams require their corresponding player ship class.
rules.coverage: The PvP planner exposes available baseline counter crews, and the scorer respects the player ship class. A class preference does not guarantee victory. Explorer baseline: Weyoun, Pon and Ikat’ika.

rules.title: Captain, bridge and below deck are distinct
rules.description: Captain maneuvers are evaluated in the captain seat, officer abilities on the bridge, and below-deck abilities only below deck. Officers cannot occupy multiple seats.
rules.coverage: All captain placements are searched within a ranked shortlist. The local compiled ability catalogue is not an authoritative rules engine; missing conditions and unsupported effects are disclosed.

rules.title: Buffs are additive within a stat category
rules.description: Large existing bonuses dilute the marginal value of more of the same stat. At +900%, adding +100% yields only a 10% real gain.
rules.formula: Marginal gain = new bonus / (1 + existing bonus)
rules.coverage: The optimizer scores ability relevance and stat dilution. The existing officer-to-ship stat conversion is approximate; raw officer stats do not establish an exact in-game combat result.

rules.title: The live game keeps evolving
rules.description: Later updates modify Academy encounters and introduce additional conditional Critical Mitigation and event effects.
rules.coverage: Update 94 station primes, timed anomalies, critical floors, weapon schedules, morale/burning/hull-breach timing, outposts and coordinated waves are not fully implemented. Never interpret the relative score as guaranteed optimality or a live win probability.

limitations: Mitigation coefficients and the 71.2% cap remain the project’s approximate model, pending battle-log validation.

Officer stat conversion, shield absorption/regeneration, firing schedules, combat-triangle modifiers, conditional captain synergy, artifacts, forbidden tech, buildings and research scopes are not exhaustively reproduced.
Wave, anomaly, dreadnought and station modes provide individual encounter crew advice, not a complete multi-ship event simulation.
Imported base stats can be stale or estimates. Validate ship and target inputs against your account before relying on numerical outcomes.
